basic_profile.bio: Avid Animal Crossing fan who recently got back into gaming after a long hiatus. I'm based in the Midwest, where I work as a freelance graphic designer. In my free time, I'm usually exploring virtual worlds or tinkering with my trackball collection. I'm single and enjoy late-night gaming sessions, often staying online until the early hours of the morning.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design with a strong interest in vintage gaming. Most of my knowledge comes from self-teaching and participating in online communities. Recently, I've been diving into the world of trackballs and learning about their mechanics.
